summary: Hard-coded test count (32) and validation dates (2026-07-01, 2026-01-15) in run-act-tests.sh make tests brittle. Missing actionlint validation step required by task (WORKFLOW STRUCTURE TESTS). PowerShell uses unusual [bool]$FailOnExpired instead of [switch]; module `-Force` import unnecessary. Core logic well-structured but needs fixture format documentation and dynamic test expectations.
